purpose: Primary-source evidence for the current corrected UniiChat audit and historical OptChat/OptMem analysis. Preserve revision history; research downloads are not distributed application source.

sources.title: UniiChat: one chat that never ends
sources.api_description: OptChat - HOW TO REPLICATE MY SETUP
sources.author: VictorTaelin
sources.revision_note: The review time, API activity time, content commit and raw-file Git blob identify different things. The file is still named optchat.md; its title is now UniiChat. Current content is a specification plus an algorithm fragment, not the complete application source.
material_changes: Merge priority uses the pair's inclusive last event instead of its first event; denominator factor four was not the ordering defect.
Append until the view exceeds 128000 bytes, then batch merges toward 64000 bytes.
Persist view.json across restarts instead of reconstructing the view from the full log.
Separate 16000-to-32000-byte compaction view and shared constant turn/compaction system-tool prefix.
Four-line cache blocks and coordination of in-flight shared-prefix writes.
Ready-node queues, revised leaf concurrency and retry at the next message.
claims_not_independently_benchmarked: 98.6% turn-prefix cache reads and 96.2% compaction-prefix reads: author reports a 3000-message replay against a model of Anthropic caching, not Agent Hub provider telemetry.
Batching cost comparison from an author-reported 30000-message simulation.
Equivalence to rollback push over 20001 steps.
Perfect or indefinite recall, absence of context rot, and provider-specific cache pricing/lifetime behavior.

sources.title: Author notice correcting the cache-breaking recipe
sources.author: VictorTaelin
sources.summary: The author says the recipe had bugs including one that broke cache reuse, asks harness builders to reread it, and points to the revised explanation of the merging algorithm.
sources.measurement_note: This comment confirms the correction notice; it does not itself establish the screenshot's cache percentage.

sources.title: User-supplied screenshot prompting the cache recheck
sources.observation: The inspected user-supplied screenshot shows the author describing an updated Gist, a cache-breaking original bug and a 98%+ cache claim.
sources.limitations: The screenshot is review context, not independent cache telemetry. The Gist qualifies its exact percentages as simulation results. No screenshot binary or inferred social-post URL is distributed.
